title: [Coalescence, Dark Chamber]
description: Darkness consumes the furthest areas of this misshapen, twisted chamber, visibility nearly absent other than the dim light provided by a virid glow that emanates from beyond an angular twisted stone archway.  Virescent tendrils undulate and swirl out of a shallow haze-shrouded pool centered in the muddy ground, ebbing as they spread toward and cling to the jagged walls.
